departments.name: Cardiology
departments.shortDescription: Comprehensive heart care, non-invasive cardiac diagnostics, angiography, and preventive cardiology.
departments.fullDescription: The Department of Cardiology at Gokul Hospital provides diagnostic evaluation and clinical management for coronary artery disease, arrhythmias, heart failure, and hypertension. Equipped with ECG, 2D Echo, TMT, and Holter monitoring suites.

departments.name: Neurology
departments.shortDescription: Specialized evaluation and management of stroke, epilepsy, migraine, neuropathy, and movement disorders.
departments.fullDescription: Our Neurology unit focuses on rapid stroke assessment, seizure management, chronic headache clinics, and neuromuscular diagnostics including EEG and nerve conduction studies.

departments.name: Orthopedics
departments.shortDescription: Bone, joint, spine, sports injury care, fracture management, and arthroscopic procedures.
departments.fullDescription: The Department of Orthopedics delivers trauma fracture fixation, joint preservation, arthritis care, sports injury rehabilitation, and spinal disorder management in coordination with Physiotherapy.

departments.name: Pediatrics
departments.shortDescription: Dedicated child healthcare, newborn care, immunization clinics, and pediatric developmental tracking.
departments.fullDescription: Our Pediatrics department offers compassionate outpatient and inpatient care for infants, children, and adolescents, including routine vaccination schedules, growth assessment, and seasonal infection management.

departments.name: Gynecology
departments.shortDescription: Maternity care, antenatal checkups, high-risk pregnancy management, and women’s health services.
departments.fullDescription: The Obstetrics & Gynecology department supports women through all stages of life, providing prenatal care, safe delivery suites, PCOS management, and minimally invasive gynecological procedures.

departments.name: Dermatology
departments.shortDescription: Clinical diagnosis and treatment of skin, hair, and nail conditions, allergies, and dermatological procedures.
departments.fullDescription: Our Dermatology clinic provides evidence-based medical treatment for eczema, psoriasis, acne, fungal infections, pigmentary disorders, and minor outpatient dermatosurgery.

departments.name: General Medicine
departments.shortDescription: Primary adult internal medicine, diabetes care, infectious diseases, thyroid, and preventive checkups.
departments.fullDescription: General Medicine serves as the primary point of clinical evaluation for adult patients, coordinating multi-system diagnosis, chronic disease management (diabetes, hypertension, thyroid), and inpatient medical care.

departments.name: General Surgery
departments.shortDescription: Laparoscopic and open surgical care for hernia, gallbladder, appendix, gastrointestinal, and soft tissue conditions.
departments.fullDescription: The Department of General & Minimal Access Surgery performs elective and emergency surgical procedures with strict sterile protocols and structured post-operative care.

departments.name: Dentistry
departments.shortDescription: Preventive dental care, root canal treatment, oral surgery, prosthodontics, and gum care.
departments.fullDescription: Our Dental Sciences unit offers hygienic, painless dental procedures including digital dental X-rays, endodontics, crowns and bridges, and preventive oral hygiene.

departments.name: Ophthalmology
departments.shortDescription: Complete eye examinations, cataract evaluation, glaucoma screening, and diabetic retinopathy checks.
departments.fullDescription: The Eye Care department provides vision testing, slit-lamp biomicroscopy, intraocular pressure measurement, and medical/surgical management of common eye conditions.

departments.name: Oncology
departments.shortDescription: Early cancer screening, preventive oncology consultations, biopsy evaluation, and supportive care.
departments.fullDescription: Our Oncology consultation unit emphasizes early detection, cancer screening protocols, multidisciplinary tumor board guidance, and compassionate supportive care.

departments.name: Radiology
departments.shortDescription: Digital X-ray, high-resolution Ultrasonography (USG), Color Doppler, and diagnostic imaging.
departments.fullDescription: The Radiology & Imaging department supports all clinical specialties with rapid, accurate diagnostic imaging adhering to radiation safety standards (ALARA).

departments.name: Emergency Medicine
departments.shortDescription: 24/7 acute medical care, trauma stabilization, cardiac emergencies, and ambulance triage.
departments.fullDescription: Gokul Hospital’s Emergency Medicine department operates 24 hours a day to triage, resuscitate, and stabilize acute medical, surgical, cardiac, and trauma emergencies.

departments.name: ENT (Otorhinolaryngology)
departments.shortDescription: Ear, nose, throat, sinus, hearing assessment, vertigo, and voice disorder management.
departments.fullDescription: The ENT department offers endoscopic evaluation and treatment for sinusitis, tonsillitis, hearing loss, ear infections, nasal polyps, and balance disorders.

departments.name: Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation
departments.shortDescription: Post-surgical rehabilitation, sports injury recovery, electrotherapy, and mobility restoration.
departments.fullDescription: Our Physiotherapy & Rehabilitation center works closely with Orthopedics and Neurology to restore patient mobility, relieve chronic pain, and accelerate post-operative recovery.

hospitalServices.title: Emergency Care
hospitalServices.shortDescription: 24/7 acute triage, trauma stabilization, cardiac resuscitation, and rapid emergency response.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Our Emergency Care unit operates round-the-clock with dedicated emergency physicians, trauma nurses, multipara monitors, and direct access to radiology and intensive care.

hospitalServices.title: Outpatient Department (OPD)
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Structured specialist consultations across 15 medical departments with digital queue and appointment scheduling.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Gokul Hospital’s Outpatient Department provides comfortable consultation chambers, vital sign pre-assessment, electronic prescriptions, and minimal waiting times.

hospitalServices.title: Inpatient Services (IPD)
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Well-ventilated general wards, twin-sharing rooms, private suites, and intensive care units.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Inpatient services at Gokul Hospital combine continuous nursing supervision, daily specialist rounds, dietitian-guided therapeutic meals, and strict infection control.

hospitalServices.title: Diagnostic Imaging Services
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Digital Radiography (X-Ray), Ultrasonography, 2D Echo, ECG, TMT, and EEG under one roof.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Accurate clinical treatment starts with reliable diagnostics. Our imaging center uses calibrated digital systems to deliver fast reports to patients and treating doctors.

hospitalServices.title: Laboratory & Pathology Services
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Automated biochemistry, hematology, clinical pathology, microbiology, and hormone assays.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Our clinical laboratory processes routine and emergency blood, urine, and tissue samples with strict internal quality controls and barcoded sample tracking.

hospitalServices.title: 24/7 Hospital Pharmacy
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Round-the-clock licensed in-house pharmacy stocking verified medicines, surgical supplies, and cold-chain biologics.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Located on the ground floor adjacent to OPD and Emergency, the Gokul Hospital Pharmacy ensures genuine, batch-verified medications with temperature-monitored storage.

hospitalServices.title: Ambulance & Patient Transport
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Basic and Cardiac Life Support (BLS/ALS) ambulances equipped with oxygen, defibrillator, and trained paramedics.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Our emergency transport fleet provides rapid patient pickup, inter-facility transfers, and continuous vital monitoring en route to Gokul Hospital.

hospitalServices.title: Master Health Checkups
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Curated preventive screening packages for cardiac, diabetic, executive, senior citizen, and women’s wellness.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Our Preventive Health Checkup lounge offers streamlined morning sample collection, imaging, and physician consultation to detect lifestyle diseases early.

hospitalServices.title: Preventive Healthcare & Vaccination
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Adult and pediatric immunization, lifestyle counseling, diabetes education, and nutritional guidance.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: We partner with families to prevent illness through scheduled immunizations, dietary counseling, smoking cessation support, and blood pressure screening.

hospitalServices.title: Modular Surgical Services
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Modern operation theatres for general, laparoscopic, orthopedic, gynecological, ophthalmic, and ENT surgeries.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Our surgical complex features HEPA-filtered laminar airflow operation theatres, central sterile supply department (CSSD), and dedicated post-anesthesia recovery bays.

hospitalServices.title: Patient Support & Helpdesk
hospitalServices.shortDescription: Admission assistance, insurance/TPA coordination desk, medical records support, and patient counseling.
hospitalServices.fullDescription: Our Patient Relations team assists families with admission formalities, cashless insurance documentation (where empaneled), cost estimates, and discharge summaries.

facilities.title: Intensive Care Unit (ICU)
facilities.description: Multipara monitored critical care beds with invasive/non-invasive ventilators, central oxygen supply, and 1:1 critical care nursing.

facilities.title: Modular Operation Theatres
facilities.description: Sterile surgical suites designed for general, laparoscopic, orthopedic, and obstetric procedures with dedicated recovery bays.

facilities.title: Patient Wards & Private Suites
facilities.description: Hygienic general wards, twin-sharing rooms, and private air-conditioned suites designed for restful recovery.

facilities.title: Integrated Diagnostic & Lab Block
facilities.description: Ground-floor diagnostic wing allowing seamless sample collection, digital X-ray, ultrasound, and ECG without stair climbing.

healthPackages.preparationInstructions: 12 hours overnight fasting required. Full bladder needed for abdominal ultrasound.

healthPackages.targetAudience: Men and women aged 60 years and above

PSA Screening (for Men) / Pap Smear or Mammogram Guidance (for Women)
healthPackages.preparationInstructions: 10–12 hours fasting recommended. Accompanied by a family member if mobility support is needed.

blogs.title: Understanding Preventive Heart Screenings: When to Schedule Your First Cardiac Check
blogs.excerpt: Regular monitoring of blood pressure, fasting lipid profiles, and HbA1c helps identify cardiovascular risk factors long before symptoms appear.

contentSections.heading: Why Baseline Cardiac Screening Matters
contentSections.body: High blood pressure and elevated LDL cholesterol frequently progress without noticeable symptoms. Establishing a baseline lipid profile, fasting blood sugar, and resting 12-lead ECG in early adulthood enables timely dietary and lifestyle interventions.

contentSections.heading: Key Tests in a Preventive Cardiac Evaluation
contentSections.body: A structured evaluation typically includes blood pressure measurement, Complete Lipid Profile, HbA1c, resting ECG, and—when clinically indicated by a physician—2D Echocardiography or a Treadmill Stress Test (TMT).

contentSections.heading: Warning Signs That Require Immediate Emergency Care
contentSections.body: Never wait for an outpatient appointment if you experience central chest pressure, pain radiating to the left arm or jaw, sudden shortness of breath, or unexplained sweating. Proceed immediately to a 24/7 Emergency Department.

blogs.medicalDisclaimer: Educational information only. This article does not constitute medical diagnosis or treatment advice. Please consult a qualified physician at Gokul Hospital for personalized evaluation.

blogs.title: Managing Seasonal Viral Fevers and Hydration in Children: A Parent’s Clinical Guide
blogs.excerpt: Learn how to monitor hydration, temperature patterns, and red-flag symptoms during seasonal weather changes, and why self-medication with antibiotics should be avoided.

contentSections.heading: Supporting Hydration and Rest
contentSections.body: Most seasonal upper respiratory infections are viral and self-limiting. Offering frequent oral fluids, WHO-approved Oral Rehydration Solution (ORS) when needed, and light home-cooked meals supports recovery.

contentSections.heading: Why Antibiotics Should Never Be Used Without Prescription
contentSections.body: Antibiotics target bacterial infections and have no effect against viral fevers. Unsupervised antibiotic use can cause gastrointestinal side effects and contribute to antimicrobial resistance.

contentSections.heading: When to Consult a Pediatrician Promptly
contentSections.body: Seek medical evaluation immediately if a child has persistent high fever beyond 3 days, lethargy, rapid breathing, refusal to take fluids, or reduced urine output.

blogs.medicalDisclaimer: Educational information only. Always consult a qualified pediatrician before giving any medication to infants or children.

blogs.title: Ergonomics, Posture, and Spine Health for Desk Professionals
blogs.excerpt: Simple workstation adjustments, micro-breaks every 45 minutes, and core strengthening exercises can prevent chronic cervical and lumbar strain.

contentSections.heading: The Impact of Prolonged Sitting on the Lumbar Spine
contentSections.body: Sitting with a slouched posture increases intradiscal pressure in the lower back and strains neck extensors. Positioning the monitor at eye level and keeping feet flat on the floor reduces mechanical stress.

contentSections.heading: The 45-Minute Micro-Break Rule
contentSections.body: Standing up for 2–3 minutes of gentle stretching and walking every 45 minutes restores circulation to paraspinal muscles and reduces stiffness.

blogs.medicalDisclaimer: Educational content only. If you experience radiating leg pain, numbness, or weakness, schedule a clinical orthopedic evaluation.
